title: Democratic Impact Monitor: Police Station Surveillance Transparency and Digital Evidence Bill
objective: Ensure 100% operational CCTV coverage in police stations and officer body-cam usage.

indicators.name: Police Station Operational CCTV Uptime
indicators.definition: Percentage of police station CCTV cameras operational with continuous 18-month backup.

oversight.composition: Judges, technical experts, human rights advocates
oversight.powers: Statutory audit and remote camera inspection

triggers.condition: Unreported CCTV camera outage exceeding 2 hours in any police station lockup or interrogation room.
